teacher: oscillator-rk4-f64-v1, exact operation order unrolled on chapter104 F64 tape

training.observed: next position and velocity; known exact initial state

noise.distribution: bounded uniform[-amplitude,+amplitude] independently for each coordinate
noise.sampling: same frozen noisy observations before selecting every stride-th next state

gradient_fit.selection: fixed final iterate; no heldout selection or retuning

grid.endpoints: inclusive bounds, row-major spring then damping, first minimum on ties

cost_scope: Matched forward-objective evaluation count; AD's additional reverse passes and graph work reported separately, not called equal arithmetic cost.

heldout.force: phase=(tick+5*episode)%20; .4 if phase<5, -.2 if phase<12, else0
heldout.observations: clean exact109RK4; no heldout observations used by fitting or grid selection

ambiguity.meaning: Nonzero equilibrium fixes spring through force/spring but supplies no damping information; distinct damping choices yield exactly identical motion.

budgets.tape_vs_original_solver: every active state F64 word identical
budgets.other_variants: Report all noise/sampling outcomes, refusals and final losses honestly; no post-result retuning.
